title: SysML-shaped JSON, version 0.10
description: A compact JSON form of a SysML v2 subset for FPGA models. One JSON object is one SysML element; relationship objects (memberships, typings, specializations) are folded into fields. Rule: no concept that SysML does not have. Generated to SysML text by layered/gen_sysml.py. Version 0.5 covers packages, attribute defs, item defs, port defs (with attributes and items), metadata defs, part defs (attributes and values, constraints, ports incl. conjugated, parts incl. subsetting and multiplicity ranges, bind, connect, perform, allocate, metadata, comments) and action defs (parameters, steps, bind, flows). A port may be untyped (`port cmd;`): valid SysML, used while exploring; generating HDL needs a port def. Version 0.7 adds attribute defs that specialize others and give values (`attribute def XCZU9EG :> ZynqUltraScalePlusDevice { :>> capacity { :>> lut = 274080; } }`): nested values, for a feature's own features. Version 0.8 adds items on ports (what a port carries) and flows on part defs (`flow from csr.request to readSensor.request;`): where a performed action's items enter and leave the part, through its ports. Version 0.9 allows an item with no item def yet (`in item temp_read;`): valid SysML, used while sketching a sequence for a bid; its item def is chosen later. Version 0.10 lets a port def specialize others (`port def Axi4LiteManager :> MemoryMappedManager`, an abstract port def: a memory-mapped bus's manager role), and gives attribute usages to port usages and connections, for the address map (decision 14): `connect crossbar.m0 to csr.csr { attribute window : AddressWindow { :>> base = 0; :>> size = 4096; } }`, and a memory map's root on the manager port where addressing starts: `port csr : AxiLite { attribute root : MemoryMapRoot { :>> map_name = "ps"; :>> base = 1073741824; } }`.

Name.description: A SysML name. Restricted to identifiers that are also legal in VHDL after lower-casing: a letter, then letters, digits and single underscores.

QualifiedName.description: A name, or a qualified name such as ScalarValues::Integer.

Doc.description: SysML `doc` text. Plain text; the generator wraps it in /* */.

Expression.description: A SysML expression, kept as text (e.g. a reference to another attribute: lanes).

Value.description: A literal (JSON boolean, number or string; a string is a SysML string literal) or an Expression.

AttributeDef.description: SysML `attribute def`: a value type (Logic, LogicVector, Analog), or a record of values (a device family's resources, a device).

redefines.description: `attribute :>> name = value;` for inherited attributes; a nested object gives values for that attribute's own features (`:>> capacity { :>> lut = 274080; }`).

Attribute.description: SysML `attribute` usage. With `direction` it is a directed feature: a signal of a port. Without it, a parameter.

direction.description: SysML feature direction, from the owning port def's side.

default.description: SysML `default` value (may be overridden where the port is used).

PortDef.description: SysML `port def`. Either lists its own attributes and items (or specializes another port def, or is abstract), or is the conjugate of another port def (`conjugateOf`).

specializes.description: `:> A, B` (0.10): e.g. a bus role that is memory-mapped, `:> MemoryMappedManager`.

conjugateOf.description: SysML conjugation: the same features (attributes and items) with in and out swapped (inout stays inout). The generator writes the features out explicitly (convention: no ~ in the text), so the two roles of an interface are kept in one place.

FeatureChain.description: A feature or a chain of features: eth_rgmii, ethernet.eth_rgmii, readTemperature.receiveFrame.

Comment.description: SysML `comment`: a note that is a model element (OPEN items, rationale). Plain // comments are not model elements and have no JSON form.

Values.description: Values for features of the type, written `attribute :>> name = value;` (a port's lanes, a metadata field). A nested object gives values for that feature's own features: `{"capacity": {"lut": 274080}}` is `attribute :>> capacity { attribute :>> lut = 274080; }`. (`expr` is not a feature name here: `{"expr": ...}` is an Expression.)

MetadataDef.description: SysML `metadata def`: a kind of fact recorded about an element (Datasheet, Resources).

MetadataUsage.description: SysML metadata applied to the owning element: `@Type { field = value; }`.

PortUsage.description: SysML `port` usage, typed by a port def; untyped (`port name;`) while the interface is still open.

name.description: The port's name. Without shortName it is the identifier (a Name); with shortName it may be readable text, e.g. 'Processing CSR'.

shortName.description: SysML short name (`port <processing> 'Processing CSR' : T;`): the identifier used in VHDL and in references (connections, binds) when the name is readable text. (0.6)

conjugated.description: `port p : ~PortDef;` (SysML conjugation). Our spike8/10 convention avoids it (explicit role pairs); layered/ uses it.

attributes.description: Attribute usages in its body (0.10): values that belong to this usage, e.g. a memory map's root (`attribute root : MemoryMapRoot { ... }`).

items.description: `in item request : TemperatureRequest;` in the port's body: the items this port carries, into or out of its part (what an action the part performs gets or gives through it).

PartUsage.description: SysML `part` usage, typed by a part def.

Binding.description: SysML `bind a = b;`: the two ends are the same thing (a part def's port and a child's port with the same port def).

Connection.description: SysML `connect a to b;`: two child ports joined (the two roles of one interface). With attributes (0.10), `connect a to b { attribute window : AddressWindow { ... } }`: e.g. the address window a crossbar's manager port gives what it reaches.

attributes.description: Attribute usages in its body (0.10), e.g. its address window.

Allocation.description: SysML `allocate from to to;` (an action step to the part that does it).

PartDef.description: SysML `part def`. Body order in the generated text: doc, comments, metadata, attributes, redefines, constraints, parts, bindings, connections, performs, allocations, flows, ports.

attributes.description: Attribute usages of the part def (parameters, generics), with defaults.

redefines.description: `attribute :>> name = value;` in the part def body (values for inherited attributes).

flows.description: `flow from csr.request to readSensor.request;` / `flow from readSensor.temperature to csr.temperature;`: an action the part def performs gets and gives its items through its ports; each end is a feature and one of its items (a port's items are declared on the port).

ItemDef.description: SysML `item def`: something that moves (a frame, a command, a reading).

Item.description: SysML directed `item` usage: `in item name : ItemDef;`, or `in item name;` while its item def is not chosen yet (a sketch: SysML allows an untyped usage). In a port def, what the port carries; in an action, a parameter.

ActionUsage.description: SysML `action` usage: a step of an action def. Either typed by an action def (`type`) or with its own parameters.

Flow.description: SysML `flow from a to b;`, or `succession flow from a to b;` when b starts after a ends (succession: true).

ActionDef.description: SysML `action def`: a behaviour. Body order in the generated text: doc, comments, parameters, actions (steps), bindings, flows.

bindings.description: `bind step.param = param;`: a step's parameter is the action def's parameter.

Constraint.description: SysML `constraint name { expr }`, or `assert constraint` (assert: true).

ReadableName.description: A SysML name that need not be an identifier (written 'Processing CSR' in SysML text). Allowed when the element also has a shortName, which is then its identifier (VHDL, references). No quote characters or line breaks.
